answer: A head keeps its berth only by paying the wharf a fresh plume each epoch, and the wharf mints a plume only to the one head it just watched finish a timed judged session, signing it to that head's key in the trellis. Plumes expire unsold — no treasury may redeem another's. A copy inherits nothing: its fork's unspent plumes stay with the original, so to match one honest agent each of k clones must serve N judged epochs of its own, k×N attested epochs on the attacker's bill, while a lone newcomer serves its first N at plain pace.
